name: Delegation Risk
description: A research framework for bounding the expected damage from delegating to AI agents: risk as the sum of probability times damage over harm channels, one composition rule for propagating it through delegation chains, runtime risk accounting in the agent harness, and the entanglement tax that correlated checks pay. Maintained by QURI (quantifieduncertainty.org) as part of the CAIRN project.
intro: Start with The Core Path (https://delegation-risk.quantifieduncertainty.org/getting-started/reading-order/). Numbers labelled illustrative are not estimates and support no conclusions. Sibling wikis: Evaluation Engineering (https://evaluation-engineering.quantifieduncertainty.org) and Robust Reasoning Processes (https://reasoning-processes.quantifieduncertainty.org).
